title: DDPAI Z50 Pro 4K Dash Cam Front + Rear US$67.61 (~A$94.76), w/ 64GB MicroSD US$71.84 (~A$100.69) Del @ DDPAI Overseas AliExpress
body:
Deal: DDPAI Z50 Pro 4K Dash Cam Front + Rear US$67.61 (~A$94.76), w/ 64GB MicroSD US$71.84 (~A$100.69) Del @ DDPAI Overseas AliExpress

[opposablethumbs] Z60 Pro front & rear goes for only about $20 more than this when on sale.
[Clear] Too bad they said no to any discounts this month and last month.
[opposablethumbs] Patience is a virtue :-).
Was lucky to snag this one.
https://www.ozbargain.com.au/node/961598
By all reports sensor on Z60 much better.
[Clear] I'm aware. Who do you think is asking Ddpai for the discounts lol :P
[adrianhughes1998] Competition hotting up, the 70mai A900 is same sensor as the Z50 Pro. Both have pros and cons.
[Clear] That's easy. Just cover the whole front of the windscreen with dashcams.
[adrianhughes1998] Oh, you mean like I did here haha: https://ibb.co/HT8zf63y
[Clear] I feel like that song is appropriate if you get pulled up by highway patrol haha. So which dashcam is the best?
[adrianhughes1998] @Clear: It is, luckily I haven't been pulled up. That photo is a couple of years old, but at the moment I have the Viofo A329T (best for image quality), best all-around integration for 4G is 70mai T800 (DDPAI Z90 Master didn't sit well with me cos of all firmware issues and separate wiring for all cams). Those are all the flagships. Vantrue has kind of been meh in the last year, solid and reliable but their E360 was a bit of a failed concept (would rather take the 70mai X800 over that).
Best budget solution I'd still say is 70mai A810 Lite (well really, their new A900 now). DDPAI is good app-wise but they need to streamline a bit).
[Clear] @adrianhughes1998: Ah that's very interesting. I actually have a DDPAI Z90 Master ready to be setup (not hardwired). Hopefully it's not too bad.
[DangerNoodle] @Clear: Use the obd hardwire kits. Quick and easy.
Swapped from my old 70mai A800 to z60 pro. Their Kickstarter campaign claimed super capacitor but the final release ended up having a battery that would shut down in summer heat and the microphone blew on two of mine. Z60 pro has been better image quality and obd hardwire kit is quick and easy.
[Clear] @DangerNoodle: You've done the same as me. In my other car I upgraded from a 70mai A800S to the Z60 Pro with the OBD hardwire kit from Amazon.
OBD port in the car with the Z90 is already occupied haha. No idea how those splitters go.
[DangerNoodle] @Clear: Did you have any microphone issues for the A800S? For my partner's car, the microphone also died on her A800S and just played a lot of popping noises.
[Clear] @DangerNoodle: Yeah it was a bit muffled so I just turned it off in the end.
[adrianhughes1998] @Clear: https://dashcamtalk.com/forum/threads/ddpai-z90-master-unbox…
https://dashcamtalk.com/forum/threads/ddpai-z90-master-dash-…
Read my threads there, should help you with the setup cos it took me a while to figure it out (not laid out properly in the manuals).
The disconnection issues were with the Mini 3X camera due to it's connection methods. It's gotten better with firmware updates, but it's still iffy.
If they can get on top of things, it's definitely a solid unit alternative to skyrocketing prices with Viofo Starvis 2 models.
The good thing is that DDPAI is listening to feedback. Other brands like Wolfbox / Redtiger didn't want a bar of me.
[ZJack] @adrianhughes1998: Are you able to recommend a good Z60 Pro level Dashcam without microphone, or with hardware disable microphone, and decent privacy creds?
[DangerNoodle] @ZJack: You could always get the Z60 pro and just disable audio recording?
[ZJack] @DangerNoodle: In the app? I’ve never had a dashcam so please excuse the ignorance, but could you have full confidence that it’s not still listening? I wouldn’t trust smart home speakers with mics if disabled in software settings, for example.
[DangerNoodle] @ZJack: Disabling the audio recording just stops the audio from being encoded onto the video. Dash cams are typically closed loop unless you run the 4g cloud optional accessories so you shouldn't really have any privacy concerns with the microphones.
If you're concerned about someone listening in (like the blackvue remote access situation), just don't go for the 4g cloud box option, switch off the wireless connectivity and run full closed loop.
[adrianhughes1998] @DangerNoodle: Exactly this.
I've stuffed up testing dashcams before by not turning the microphone on in the app, or turning it off via button accidentally haha
[NervousValuable] Is the SanDisk Max Endurance 256GB overkill for this?
[FeZZa21] I nabbed a 512GB Lexar blue series for $99 recently for my z60 pro lol was pricing error as standard was $299, but shop honored it https://www.rubbermonkey.com.au/Lexar-512GB-High-Performance…
[backupper1] viofo like for like models, are these on par or better?
[bogak] Viofo uses the Sony STARVIS 2 sensors, think they started using the STARVIS 2 sensor for quite some time now, 2022/2023? and yes STARVIS 2 sensor is way better than what's on DDPAI Z50 Pro/A900 sensor(Sony IMX415).
